scope: Owner direction and review synchronization; no mechanic or engine implementation.

ownerGameDirection.verbatim:
I would love a full 3d rendition MMO style game but I know that is technically impossible with CODEX. What I am planning is a SNES Style CRPG with 3 base games.

The exploration, Tactical, Resource Management.

Exploration-self explanatory. I was thinking free control like Secret of Mana where you can run and Jump, use simple mapped commands to explore, dig, mark, open chest doors etc.

Tactical.
True CRPG (think owlcat)

Resource Management,
Where you can hit all the crafting and research systems, send ai partnerrs to do certain tasks, (fishing, mining, farming etc)

modes.direction: Direct control inspired by Secret of Mana, with running, jumping and mapped interactions including exploration, digging, marking, doors and chests.
Deep CRPG combat; Owlcat is a depth reference, not authority to import its rules.
Crafting, research and companion assignments such as fishing, mining and farming.

ownerGameDirection.scopeCaution: The owner describes a desired format; the incidental belief that 3D is technically impossible with Codex is not adopted as a technical fact. No existing content or benefit is removed.

proposals: Unity presentation over shared C# state and rules, with exploration, combat and management command layers.
Shared character, inventory, world and scheduling state; animations display resolved outcomes.
Saved companion jobs continue when their presentation unloads.
Validated commands and side-effect-free previews with information visibility preserved.
Prove a connected exploration/combat/assignment/save-load loop using sufficiently reviewed content.
unsettled: Exact exploration/combat/work time conversion and menu/pause policy.
Movement, jumping, party following and encounter transition policies.
Turn-based-first recommendation, cooperative details and prototype roster/content are not newly owner-approved exact mechanics.
No Unity project inspection, engine implementation, compile or runtime validation occurred in this synchronization.

mechanicalDecisions.decision: One shared 24-hour maximum; nonconcentration; no new consumed reagent. Preserve existing RP, components, actual class access, tasks and early endings.
Combine the printed perception benefits consistently across legitimate acquisition routes, retaining distinct access and physical occlusion/transformation limits.

Spend applicable copied-feat and actually owned Mirrorsage allowances on preparation only. Delayed release spends its real Reaction without requiring or spending a second copy allowance for the release round. RP, components and capture permission are paid once; counter/abandon does not refund preparation.
retainedRequirements: All separate action and resource requirements
mechanicalDecisions.scope: Copied-feat Ready only; no ordinary Ready or unrelated Echo change. It grants no extra actions.
